verdict.rationale: Finix documents an official MCP server, confirmed by a probe, and provides a setup guide for connecting Claude Code to it. The documented scope is limited to asking questions about the Finix API and getting documentation-based answers. Missing for 10: MCP tools that act on account resources (payments, payouts, disputes) rather than only answering documentation questions, setup guides for clients beyond Claude Code, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
